notes.title: Symphonia 1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Symphonia 1.1.2 Patch Notes

Hello everyone!

This update will be fairly short. We've mainly fixed bugs that could hinder the game experience, while waiting for a new update for minor level design balancing. Some bugs may persist, while others are still in the process of being fixed.

Bugs : 


 Fixed a bug that can briefly lock the player into its bounce on a string animation
 Fixed a bug that prevented the respawn sound to play in certain conditions
 Fixed a bug that prevented the room transitions to occur in some rooms (in Brass and Woodwinds)
 Added safety measures to avoid a rare bug where Philemon gets stuck in its playing the violin state
 Fixed a bug that allowed Philemon to go under a horizontal string with the grappling bow
 Fixed a bug that prevented the Kinglet to appear in the machine at the end of the Brass Palace
 Fixed various sound issues around concerts and post concerts
 Fixed minor visual issues in the backgrounds in the Introduction area


We'd like to thank the GDQ Hotfix for the partnership we had with them last month. The runs shown were impressive and it gives us great pleasure as developers to see people pushing the game to its limits! If you can to catch it up, you can go on the GDQ Youtube channel.

If some bugs are persistent you can always report them in our Discord server. Thanks again for your feedback and for playing the game. See you for the next patch!

Musically yours,
Sunny Peak 🌄

notes.title: Symphonia 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Symphonia 1.1.1 Patch Notes

Hello everyone!

First, the whole Sunny Peak team wishes you all a happy new year! This patch mainly covers level design and camera tweaks, alongside light bug fixes. Other patches will be coming in early 2025 to add more level design tweaks and fix more bugs; some of them take some time to find and fix.


Level Design : 


 S22: Moved up the collectible
 S23: Reduced the height of the central pillar
 S24: Removed a cushion on the top left and added a one-way platform
 S30: Light killzone colliders rework in the collectible area
 S37: Simplified the transition to the first vertical string
 S41: Moved the first checkpoint farther to the right
 S42: Removed spikes and a pillar in the second section
 B19: Adjusted the third pendulum timing to match with the rest of them
 B29: Moved the bottom right bell farther to the left
 B36: Inverted rotating block faces

Camera:


 Tweaked camera movements to make them more fluid in those rooms : S7, S42, W31, B24

Bugs : 


 Fixed a bug that can softlock the player if they die at the very end of the escape sequence in Brass
 Fixed a bug that can softlock the player inside the Wayfarer Tune menu when dying while having it open
 Fixed an animation bug that can lock Philemon when landing on a horizontal string with a double jump
 Fixed minor audio and animation issues
 Other tiny modifications


Thanks again for your feedback and for playing the game. See you for the next patch!

Musically yours,
Sunny Peak 🌄

notes.title: Symphonia 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello dear platforming lovers ! 

Today sees the launch of our first patch since launch day… It is a pretty big one, as we tried to tackle some of the most important problems we have been seeing in this first week : confusions about some features, and some annoyingly common bugs. Thanks again to the Symphonia Discord members for sending us your bugs, that really helps fixing them faster !

Without waiting, here are the patch notes for Symphonia 1.1.0 (spoilers ahead !) : 

Features : 

- Reworked the settings menu to clarify the utility of gameplay variants.
- Added a new warning popup, that appears if you enter secret areas without having the core abilities needed to complete the area.
- Added a new achievement, related to aura shards !
- Added a new splash screen (Razer Interhaptics).
- Changed the credits to include new entries for Razer Interhaptics.
- Removed the debug input for the camera movements.

Bugs : 

- Fixed a bug on the horizontal strings that allowed you to clip under when using the double jump on them.
- Fixed a bug that changed Philemon’s orientation when he died and stuck on a cushion at the same time.
- Fixed a bug that froze Philemon when using the grappling bow on a horizontal string.
- Fixed a bug that caused coins to instantly teleport if you died while collecting them.
- Fixed a bug that displayed unwanted dust vfx when the player tried to move during one of the Trickster’s cutscenes.
- Fixed a bug that caused Philemon to be unable to use the Wayfarer Tune in the Palace Jail.
- Fixed a bug that made the catapult preview and grappling bow trail go behind the scenery sometimes.
- Fixed a bug that caused some animation issues when using alt+tab at specific moments.
- Fixed a bug that caused Philemon’s animation to be wrong when launching the cutscene in the second room of Palace Jail.
- Fixed a bug that lowered the audio volume when dying while playing the Wayfarer Tune.
- Attempt to fix the bug that causes some rooms to not load sometimes.
- Fixed minor issues in audio.
- Fixed minor animation issues.
- Fixed many other tiny bugs and imprecise behaviors.

Thanks again for this awesome launch week and see you next week for another patch !

Musically yours,
Sunny Peak 🌄
